title: Multidex — An offline Pokédex for Android and the web
description: Multidex is an unofficial Pokédex for Android and the web. Browse species, moves, types and abilities, keep opened entries offline, and unlock extras with optional Multidex Plus.

hero.title: Your Pokédex, ready offline.
hero.description: Species, moves, types and abilities from PokéAPI, in a fast Material You Pokédex. Every entry you open stays on your device.
hero.note: Free to browse, with no account needed. Multidex Plus is optional.

tools.title: Species and Pokémon
tools.description: Browse every species and form with stats, abilities, evolutions and flavor text.

tools.title: Moves, types and abilities
tools.description: Look up moves, type matchups and abilities, with search across every list.

tools.title: Offline after first open
tools.description: Entries you open are saved on your device and refresh in the background when you're online.

tools.title: Names in your language
tools.description: Pokémon names and descriptions in the languages PokéAPI provides.

tools.title: Phone, tablet and web
tools.description: Adaptive layouts for phones, tablets and the browser, with colors drawn from each Pokémon's artwork.

tools.title: Accounts when you want them
tools.description: Sign in with Google to keep Multidex Plus with your account, and switch between saved accounts.

freeFeatures: Species, Pokémon, moves, types and abilities
Offline entries after the first open
Names and descriptions in multiple languages
plusFeatures: Shiny artwork, with an encounter rate you control
Visual themes, search placement and more

faqs.question: Is Multidex an official Pokémon app?
faqs.answer: No. Multidex is a fan-made app and isn't affiliated with or endorsed by Nintendo, Creatures, GAME FREAK or The Pokémon Company. Its data comes from PokéAPI.

faqs.question: Do I need an account?
faqs.answer: No. Everything free works without signing in. Sign in with Google when you want Multidex Plus to stay with your account.

faqs.question: Does it work offline?
faqs.answer: Yes, for entries you've already opened. Multidex saves them on your device and refreshes them in the background when you're online.

faqs.question: Is Multidex suitable for younger fans?
faqs.answer: Multidex has no ads and doesn't use the advertising ID. Sign-in and Plus are optional, and younger fans should use them with a parent or guardian.

faqs.question: How do I cancel Multidex Plus?
faqs.answer: Cancel it in Google Play's subscriptions. Plus stays active until the end of the period you've paid for.

faqs.question: How do I delete my account?
faqs.answer: Choose Delete account in the account menu or Settings, or email us if you no longer have the app.
